description: Open-source AI model/dataset-hosting platform. NVIDIA filed an 8-K on September 2, 2026 for a ~$11.9B cash acquisition (plus ~$1B in employee retention equity), per The Information's earlier report of a $12.9B deal. Hugging Face's 2023 round had valued it at $4.5B; it reportedly turned down a $500M NVIDIA investment in 2025. Close expected H1 2027.

A ~$2.5B fund HUMAIN — Saudi Arabia's PIF-owned AI company — is raising from global and domestic investors, per Bloomberg sources, to finance Saudi data-center buildout (an initial 250MW site with Al Moammar Information Systems, scaling toward 1GW). To be managed by BSF Capital (Banque Saudi Fransi's investment arm); PIF's direct role in the fund itself is unconfirmed.

Humanoid-robotics company behind the Helix AI models. Per eWeek/The Information, NVIDIA is reportedly weighing a further ~$1B investment at a ~$38B pre-money valuation — not yet an announced deal. NVIDIA already backed Figure's September 2025 Series C (>$1B at a $39B post-money valuation, led by Parkway Venture Capital, with Brookfield).

AI startup behind Jev, a model that returns typed values to code rather than prose, for routing, classification and verification workflows. Founded by ex-OpenAI researcher Diogo Almeida. Andreessen Horowitz led an $870M Series A (Oct 9, 2026) at a $7.5B valuation, joined by Sequoia and DCVC — three weeks after a $40M DCVC-led seed.

target: STT GDC (ST Telemedia Global Data Centres)
description: Asia-Pacific-focused data-center operator (2.3GW design capacity across 12 markets in APAC, the UK and Europe). A KKR-led consortium with Singtel agreed Feb 4, 2026 to buy the remaining 82% from founder ST Telemedia for S$6.6B (~S$13.8B enterprise value), leaving KKR with 75% and Singtel 25%; close expected H2 2026.

Startup paying people to record everyday tasks via body sensors and smartphones, selling the resulting human-motion data (its "Egoverse" dataset) to humanoid-robot developers. Raised a $60M Series B led by Sequoia (announced Oct 7, 2026), joined by NVIDIA, Microsoft's and Qualcomm's venture arms, Samsung, and returning investors Kindred, Framework and Neo.

San Francisco personal-AI-agent startup (legally Spear Street Technology, Inc.), reached by text or phone call, founded by Noah Shinn; still invite-only. Raised a $1B Series C at a $10B valuation led by Sequoia, Benchmark and Coatue (announced Sept 28, 2026) — roughly 4x the $2.5B mark from its $250M Series B just a month earlier.

New missile-defense component supplier formed by Blackstone-managed funds combining TSC and Applied Systems Engineering (ASEI); makes seekers/radar, guidance electronics, control actuation and GPS-denied navigation for interceptor systems. Announced Oct 1, 2026. Financial terms undisclosed (one unconfirmed trade report cites roughly $1B). CEO: Brandon Wolfson; chairman: Jonathan Moneymaker, per press coverage.

AI-agent platform turning plain-language goals into retail trading plans (research, strategy, execution — always with user approval before a trade). Founded 2025 by Justin Zheng and Dylan Iskandar. Closed a $30M seed led by Sequoia (Oct 8, 2026), joined by Jump Trading, PeakXV, Lux Capital, AntiFund, Coinbase and Premji Invest.
